items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think Louis DeLio, you know, big guy, Larry Nelson. All those folks. He was born on La Harp and raised right in that section. [INTERVIEWEE] Brown in that section. That's the section he came up.

ctx.x: Well, he moved in several spots. That was the spot where I was born. Prior to that, he was living on Dourmen Street right across from the Artesian Hall. That's where the three older children were born. And me and my younger sister, we were born on the Robertson Street address. Now, after we left the Robertson Street address, that's where we moved down on Ennett, where my father died down in that section. But originally, he came up right at La Harp and Claiborne, right across from where Muley is, a place of…
I think Louis DeLio, you know, big guy, Larry Nelson. All those folks. He was born on La Harp and raised right in that section.
Brown in that section. That's the section he came up.
